integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the LEFT definition, fixed-p recurrence, convergence and stability analysis, truncation proposal, and conclusions. The sharp factor follows from a spectral operator bound, and a two-dimensional exact-line-search family proves sharpness. Symbolic verification replays the derivation from the packaged artifact.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the fixed-parameter LEFT variant on strictly convex quadratics. It does not classify the original angle-dependent p_k rule or long-run optimal rates. The sharp witness is a two-dimensional supremal family approached after one exact line-search warm-up.
title: Sharp transient frontier for the fixed-parameter LEFT Barzilai--Borwein extension
